Industry-Specific Guidelines
3.1
Accounting and Financial Services
Overview
This subsection addresses underwriting considerations for businesses operating within
the accounting and financial services sectors. These businesses typically include certified public
accountants (CPAs), bookkeeping services, tax preparers, financial planners, investment advisors,
and other related professional service providers. Given the nature of their work—primarily involving
advisory, fiduciary, and record-keeping functions—these businesses face unique risks that differ from
traditional retail or manufacturing operations. The Business Owners Policy (BOP) for these entities
must be carefully tailored to address exposures related to professional liability, data security, and
regulatory compliance, while also covering standard property and general liability exposures.
